web_sources.title: Gate API perpetual futures: contract schema
web_sources.claim: Current schema describes direct/inverse types, multiplier, decimal-size capability and contract states. create_time is creation; delisting_time is reduce-only; delisted_time is delisting. launch_time description says contract expiry, so first-tradable meaning is unresolved.
web_sources.locator: Contract response schema; enable_decimal, order_size_min/max, create_time, launch_time, delisting_time, delisted_time.
limitations: Living documentation, not historical contract metadata or a current API response.
Examples do not establish BTC/ETH or all-contract current settings/count.
Minimum order quantity is not automatically a quantity increment.
No complete historical catalogue, effective metadata or arrival evidence obtained.
